Arey Oh Sham Walo Nadeem Sarwar Lyrics
Sakina Ki Sada Hai Aray Oh Sham Walo, Aray Oh Kofay Walo.
Kafan Baba Ko De Do Aray Oh Sham Walo, Aray Oh Kofay Walo.
Mere Pyaray Jo Ammo Aaj Hotey.
Kabhi Na Iss Qadar Majboor Hotey.
Gadayi Kar Ke Latay Magar Tum Se Na Kehte.
Chacha Ka Sar Yeh Naizay Se Hata Do.
Sar-e-Shabeer Pe Pardah Urha Do.
Yeh Gham Kitna Bara Hai Meri Maa Be Rida Hai.
Main Khatoon-e-Jinna Ka Aaina Hoon.
Rasan Basta Aseer-o-Be Rida Hoon.
Meri Janib Na Dekho Mera Kurta Phata Hai.
Woh Seena Mere Baba Ka Kahan Hai.
Suna Hai Bar Sar-e-Raig-e-Thaan Hai.
Nahi Haye Woh Seena Kahan Soye Sakina.
Mere Ghar Ki Kaneezein Ba Rida Hain.
Qayamat Ho Gayi Hum Be Rida Hain.
Sitam Kitna Bara Hai Phophi Ka Sar Khula Hai.
Yateemo Ko Satana Kab Rawa Hai.
Dukhay Dil Ko Dukhana Kab Rawa Hai.
Sitam Jo Chahe Kar Lo Magar Ik Kam Kar Do.
Rehai Ki Tamana Mar Chuki Hai.
Yeh Zindaan Meri Manzil Aakhri Hai.
Magar Baba Se Kehna Ab Aana Sham Aana.
Karo:REHAN-o-SARWAR: Aah-o-Zaari.
Sakina Ne Woh Shab Kaisay Guzari.
Tha Sar Godi Mein Sheh Ka Labon Par Tha Yeh Noha.

item.text:
Reconstructed all 26 verses in Urdu script and verified that they align line by line with the Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`. Updated the titles and right-to-left direction, removed the `noUrdu` tag, and retained Nadeem Sarwar’s attribution in the reciter field.

The Roman phrase “Raig-e-Thaan” is ambiguous. I rendered it as `ریگِ تھاں` to stay close to the supplied reading.
